title: Chapter 326 A Huge City
content:
Chapter 326 A Huge City

Time flies, and I don’t know how many years pass.

This day.

Lu Daosheng and the others finally returned to the starting point.

Not far away in front of you is that continent with fairy aura.

Fairyland.

But at this moment, the atmosphere in the fairy world is a bit depressing.

Above the fairy world, countless dense creatures were staring at the fairy world with a look of madness in their eyes.

The day of the decisive battle is approaching!

"The fairy world will eventually be the thing in our pockets."

A creature with a deep breath, a human-shaped figure, but very different shape stared at the direction of the fairy world and smiled gloomyly.

At the same time, within the fairy world.

Inside a domineering and magnificent Supreme Hall.

Hundreds of powerful figures were standing here, the atmosphere was heavy.

The ones who are at the forefront have an unfathomable aura.

The person in charge was a woman wearing a blue long dress, with three thousand black hairs as waterfalls as her waist. Her delicate face was particularly cold at this moment, and her whole body was even more terrifying. chill.

There is no time to practice. In a blink of an eye, Lu Xue has grown to the peak of the fairy world.

His cultivation level has reached the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm, with amazing combat power. Looking at the fairy world, no one can match it.

However, even so, Lu Xue still had no glory on her face.

The enemy is far stronger than she thought.

She alone can't deal with it at all.

"Leader, let's fight to the decisive battle. This day will come sooner or later."

A strong man stepped forward and clasped his fists and looked at Lu Xue with respect.

This person is Xiao Luo.

At this moment, he also reached the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

It is only one step away from the Immortal Emperor Realm.

There are many more people like him.

But now, they don’t have so much time for the rest to break through.

Since the great enemy of the fairy world has arrived.

The forces in the Immortal World let go of their past grudges, united together, and created the Immortal World Alliance.

As the ceiling of the battle power of the fairy world, Lu Xue is naturally the well-deserved leader of the fairy world alliance.

Now, she also felt the sense of responsibility of her father in the past.

Unfortunately, she is not as capable as her father to push all dangers.

In order to protect the fairy world, she took out her resources and shared them with everyone, which gave the fairy world a group of top strong men.

But, not enough.

If so, she can break through to the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Then this matter is much simpler.

Just how to break through to the Immortal Emperor Realm.

She asked these powerful people in the Immortal Emperor Realm, and their answers were all different.

Finally, Lu Xue came to a conclusion.

If you want to make a breakthrough, the most important thing is your heart.

"Wait a little longer and give me some time."

Leaving this sentence, Lu Xue turned around and left.

When they were in place, everyone looked at each other and was silent.

They have seen each other's strength, and they are not at the same level at all.

Even if the war begins now, the ending will not be different.

But they had no other way.

I have thought of everything I can think of.

Unless the leader Lu Xue can really make a breakthrough.

If there was enough time, they naturally believed in Lu Xue, but time was too hasty.

You know, Lu Xue has just broken through to the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

well.

A sigh sounded from the hall.

It's endless.

And at this time, outside the fairy world.

"Have the patriarch not out of seclusion yet?"

"No."

"Hmph, forgot, even if the clan leader doesn't come out, it's enough to crush these low-level creatures."

The purple-eyed creature stared at the direction of the fairy world, and murderous intent kept gushing out in his eyes.

In the battle of luck that year, all the younger generation they sent to the fairy world died tragically, and none of them were spared.

This matter alone has sufficient reason to destroy the entire immortal world.

Of course, the most important thing is fear.

You know, their younger generation cannot beat the younger generation in the fairy world, so what does that mean?

This means that with time and time change, the immortal realm will be stronger than them.

This is something they will never allow.

"Sir! Sir! Have a major discovery!!"

At this time, a panicked creature suddenly ran over.

Seeing this, the purple-eyed creature frowned slightly.

"Why are you yelling so hard?"

"Sir, I found a city there, which is extremely strange."

"City? What city?"

"It's just a city. I want to go in and take a look, but there seems to be a seal on it, so I can't get in."

Hearing this, the purple-eyed creature became interested.

"Take me to see."

"Yes, sir."

Immediately, the purple-eyed creature led a group of strong men toward the depths of the starry sky.

I don't know how long it took, a magnificent city appeared in their sight.

The giant city stood there like a miracle, and everything around it seemed to be worshiping it.

"this,,"

At this moment, even the knowledgeable purple-pupil creature was shocked at this moment.

"Treasure, a peerless treasure!"

"I announce that this city belongs to my Wutuo tribe!"

Wu Tuoxin said excitedly.

Immediately, Wu Tuoxin stepped forward carefully and looked at the giant city in front of him.

However, no matter how he looked, he could not see through it at all, and he could not even see the appearance of the mainland.

The eyes are filled with hazy.

"interesting."

The more this happens, the more excited he becomes.

Buzz —

He touched his hand on the city wall, and suddenly, a vast sealing force surged out.

This scene scared him so much that he quickly retracted his hand.

"It's really a seal, it's very strong, but it's not unbreakable."

Wu Tuoxin shook his head, his eyes becoming more and more confident.

He didn't know that the seal of the giant city in front of him had been weakened countless times.

And it will break automatically in the near future.

And his appearance will allow this supreme giant city to break the seal ahead of schedule.

The consequences caused are unknown.

At this time, a powerful force had already condensed in Wu Tuoxin's hands.

The next moment, he pushed his palms hard.

The powerful force suddenly seemed like a tide, constantly invading the seal on the surface of the giant city.

Seeing this, people on the side joined in one after another.

That's it, I don't know how long it took.

"Damn it, this seal is so strong!"

He clearly felt that the seal was gradually weakening, but it just didn't dissipate, which made him a little puzzled.

"Sir, why don't you go and call them here, it might be faster."

Upon hearing this, Wu Tuoxin hesitated for a moment and nodded slightly.

"Okay, go."

After a moment.

In the fairy world.

"Huh? Why are those guys getting fewer and fewer?"

Looking at the departure of those extraterrestrial creatures above the fairy world, everyone was puzzled.

"Go and notify the leader."

"yes."

A while later.

"Sir, I have made a major discovery."

Chu Lingsheng found Lu Xue and said proudly.

"explain."

Looking at Chu Lingsheng, Lu Xue said in a faint voice.

"A giant city."

"Giant city?"

Lu Xue's eyes suddenly widened and she quickly stood up.

"What does it look like?"

Seeing Lu Xue's reaction so much, Chu Lingsheng was a little startled and stuttered when he spoke.

"That's right, outside the sky, the group of people from the Wutuo tribe discovered a giant city, which seemed to be breaking the seal of the giant city."

"That giant city is very big, how can I describe it? It's very awesome."

Hearing this, Lu Xue was already breathing rapidly.

God helps me?
